title: Cover public static daemon cause members in the recovery catalog guard
outcome: The product catalog expectation test covers every declared DaemonFailureCause regardless of static member visibility, while keeping current explicit recovery expectations.
acceptance: The catalog expectation guard includes public and non-public static cause members, and a focused discrimination check demonstrates that a public static catalog cause cannot evade the explicit expectation check.

completion.summary: Catalog test inventories the actual registry, including public/static declarations. Deliberate extra public cause passed old guard, failed new guard; temporary declaration removed. Implemented and full-union reviewed; not committed or pushed.
